strings.subtitle: — Umusenya w'inyandiko —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Gukurura no kureka ntibiboneka. Koresha buto yo hepfo.
strings.ssd_warning:
Iburira! Kuri SSD, uburyo bwo kwandika hejuru ntibwemeza gusenya kubera TRIM.
Iyi porogaramu ni iya HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Inyandiko "{name}" izokwandikwa hejuru kandi isibwe.

Komeza?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• Imigezi y'amakuru y'ubundi buryo ya NTFS (ADS) ntiraba.
• Ikinyamakuru USN nticyisukurwa.
• Kopi z'igicucu n'ihuza ry'ibicu
  (OneDrive n'ibindi) ntibigira ingaruka.
strings.status_full: Ibiri muri inyandiko byanditswe hejuru rwose ku busa. Gusubiza ntibishoboka — ibikoresho bizobona gusa ubusa.
strings.status_fast: Umutwe, umurizo n'imirongo 4 MB byanditswe hejuru. Ibisigaye ntibyakozweho, ariko kubera umwanya, gusubiza byuzuye n'ibikoresho by'abakoresha ntibishoboka. Ku nyandiko z'ibanga koresha uburyo BWUZUYE.
strings.status_empty: Inyandiko yari ubusa, kwandika hejuru ntibyari ngombwa. Yasibwe.
strings.error_permission: Ntishoboka kugera ku nyandiko. Ishobora kuba ifunguye muri porogaramu indi. Funga hanyuma ugerageze.
strings.error_is_symlink: Iyi ni umurongo w'ikimenyetso. Imirongo ntishobora gusenywa — inyandiko ntego izoguma yuzuye.
strings.error_reparse: Iyi ni inyandiko y'ahantu (OneDrive cyangwa nkayo). Amakuru yayo ari mu bicu, atari kuri disiki — nta kintu cyo gusenya hano.
strings.error_not_file: Iyi ntabwo ari inyandiko (ububiko cyangwa ikindi). Reka inyandiko.
strings.error_hardlinks: Iyi nyandiko ifite izindi nzira zikomeye ({n} byose). Inzira zikomeye nta nkuru ifite — amazina yose angana. Niba usenya unyuze mu nzira ya none, amakuru azokwandikwa hejuru kandi acishwe kuri bayiti 32, ariko ibisigaye bizoguma bigerwaho binyuze mu zindi nzira. Banza usibe inzira zose.
strings.error_compressed:
Inyandiko yakozwe, yashyizwemo ibanga cyangwa ni yoroheje. Kwandika hejuru ku busa ntibyemeza gusenya amakuru ya kera kubera NTFS ibika mu bundi buryo.

Kuraho ikiranga: kanda iburyo → Ibiranga → By'umwihariko → kuraho akamenyetso ka "Kugabanya" na/cg "Gushyira ibanga". Hanyuma ukoresha SHREDDER ukundi.
